title: Your Chrome (full control)
summary: The tab you attached in JevRev Claw, driven by Playwright through PANINI's scoped relay: trusted clicks and keys, uploads, dialogs, frames; only the attached tab.

principles: chrome_* tools act in the person's own attached Chrome tab with real clicks and keys; prefer them over the basic browser tool when they are available.
Work from the latest snapshot: act on element refs and describe each element exactly as the snapshot names it.
If the person stops control (Chrome's Cancel button) or changes the attached tab, stop and tell them; do not try another route into their browser.

tools.name: chrome_navigate
tools.title: Open a page
tools.description: Open a web address in the person's own Chrome tab they attached in JevRev Claw (their logged-in browser). Returns the page's accessibility snapshot with element refs.

tools.name: chrome_snapshot
tools.title: Read the page
tools.description: Read the current page in the person's attached Chrome tab as an accessibility snapshot: text, controls and element refs (e12) to act on.

tools.name: chrome_click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click an element in the person's attached Chrome tab by its ref from the latest snapshot. Describe the element exactly as the snapshot names it. Returns the page state after the click.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: chrome_type
tools.title: Type
tools.description: Type text into a field in the person's attached Chrome tab by its ref; submit: true presses Enter afterwards. Never for passwords or security codes.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: chrome_select
tools.title: Choose an option
tools.description: Choose one or more options in a dropdown in the person's attached Chrome tab by its ref.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: chrome_press_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Press a key in the person's attached Chrome tab, for example Enter, Escape, ArrowDown or PageDown.

tools.name: chrome_wait_for
tools.title: Wait
tools.description: Wait until text appears in the person's attached Chrome tab, or for a number of seconds (at most 30). Use an empty string or 0 for the unused field.

tools.name: chrome_tabs
tools.title: Tabs
tools.description: List the attached tab (and, in a workspace, its tabs) in the person's Chrome; PANINI does not open or close their tabs. index: -1 when unused; url: empty.

tools.name: chrome_back
tools.title: Go back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the person's attached Chrome tab.

tools.name: chrome_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page in the person's attached Chrome tab.

tools.name: chrome_verify_text
tools.title: Check text is visible
tools.description: Check that a text is visible on the current page in the person's attached Chrome tab; use it to confirm a result before reporting it.
